summary: Athena Technology Acquisition Corp. II filed an 8-K on October 15, 2026, disclosing that on October 14, 2026 it notified Continental Stock Transfer & Trust Company, trustee of its trust account, of a one-month extension of its deadline to consummate an initial business combination, from October 14, 2026 to November 14, 2026. The company authorized a $271.48 deposit into the trust account in connection with the extension. This is the fifth of up to nine permitted monthly extensions under the company's Amended and Restated Certificate of Incorporation. The filing carries no deal terms, board recommendation, or advisor disclosure, and signals continued search for a target within a narrowing SPAC timeline.
